title: Puttering Pebble Cuttlefish
statement: A palm-sized cuttlefish with fluttering skirt-fins drifts through tea-blue water, its skin blooming with apricot checks whenever it discovers something worth inspecting. Beneath a slant of honey-colored light, it patiently arranges porcelain pebbles around a slate arch, then moves one just far enough to let the light through.
